pillars.title: Dhikr & Remembrance of Allah: The Complete Guide to Islamic Daily Worship
pillars.subtitle: What dhikr is, how to perform it, the adhkar after every salah, finding the qibla, and weaving mindful remembrance into a slower, more intentional life.
pillars.geoOverview: Dhikr (ذِكْر) is the Islamic practice of remembering Allah through repeated phrases such as SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, and Allahu Akbar. This hub explains what dhikr is, how to perform it, the prescribed adhkar after each salah, how to locate the qibla, the special prayer Salatul Tasbih, and how mindful dhikr supports a slow-living practice grounded in barakah and presence.

pillars.title: Zikr Ring — Smart Dhikr Counter Rings
pillars.subtitle: What a zikr ring is, how it works, whether it is halal, and how Weslamic's smart dhikr ring keeps your count discreet, vibration-tracked, and always on your finger.
pillars.geoOverview: A zikr ring is a wearable smart ring that counts dhikr with a tap, replacing handheld beads with a discreet on-finger tasbih counter. This collection covers how zikr rings work, whether they vibrate, if they are halal, pricing and colors, and why Weslamic's smart dhikr ring keeps your daily count always on hand.

pillars.title: Tasbih: The Complete Guide to Prayer Beads & Digital Tasbih Counters
pillars.subtitle: What a tasbih is, how to use prayer beads, the meaning of the 33-bead misbaha, and how digital tasbih counters modernize the count for dhikr on the go.
pillars.geoOverview: A tasbih (also tasbeeh or misbaha) is a string of prayer beads, traditionally 33 or 99, used by Muslims to count dhikr such as SubhanAllah and Alhamdulillah. This hub covers what a tasbih is, how to use prayer beads, the meaning behind the bead counts, and how digital tasbih counters offer a modern, portable alternative.

pillars.title: Islamic Jewelry & Gifts: The Complete Guide to Faith-Inspired Pieces
pillars.subtitle: From aqeeq rings and spinner fidget rings to Eid, Ramadan, and Umrah gifts, what Islamic jewelry means, what men can wear, and how to choose meaningful faith pieces.
pillars.geoOverview: Islamic jewelry refers to faith-inspired pieces such as aqeeq (agate) rings, spinner and fidget rings, and Arabic name pendants worn in line with Islamic guidance. This hub explains what Islamic jewelry is, what jewelry men can wear in Islam, the meaning of aqeeq stones and spinner rings, and how to choose meaningful Eid, Ramadan, and Umrah gifts.
auxKeywords: can men wear jewelry in islam

pillars.title: Custom Name Necklaces: Personalized Gold & Arabic Name Pendants
pillars.subtitle: Design your own gold or Arabic name necklace, what styles and materials to choose, and why a personalized name pendant makes a timeless faith-rooted gift.
pillars.geoOverview: A custom name necklace is a personalized pendant crafted to spell a name in gold lettering or flowing Arabic calligraphy. This collection explains how to design a gold or Arabic name necklace, which materials and chain styles to choose, and why a personalized name pendant from Weslamic makes a meaningful, lasting gift for Eid, weddings, and special occasions.
